# Grants and Awards

```{r grant-helpers}
# Escape LaTeX specials by hand so the total can be set in bold
esc <- function(x) gsub("([$&%#_])", "\\\\\\1", x)

grants <- vroom::vroom("data/grant.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(
        across(everything(), ~ replace_na(as.character(.x), "")),
        when   = fmt_dates_text(when),
        funder = if_else(where != "", glue::glue("{with}, {where}"), with),
        amount = if_else(
            asu != "",
            glue::glue("\\textbf{{{esc(why)}}} / ASU: {esc(asu)}"),
            glue::glue("\\textbf{{{esc(why)}}}")
        )
    )

grant_entries <- function(df) {
    vitae::detailed_entries(
        mutate(df, what = esc(what), funder = esc(funder)),
        what = what, when = when, with = funder, where = amount,
        .protect = FALSE
    )
}
```

```{r grants-awarded}
grants %>% filter(status != "Pending") %>% grant_entries()
```

## Pending

```{r grants-pending}
grants %>% filter(status == "Pending") %>% grant_entries()
```
